text: I am writing to you on behalf of students Leslieville Public School who have contacted me to request City of Toronto by-law enforcement officers be allowed enforce city by-laws regarding dogs on school property in connection with a licensed day care operating in that school and those children using the school yard. Leslieville Public School in my ward has a licensed childcare centre operated by WoodGreen Community Services. There is also an after school program run through Eastview Community Centre, one of the City of Toronto Association of Community Centres. Both of them use the school yard for their programs. The Community Development and Recreation Committee: 1. Directed the Acting Deputy City Manager, Cluster A to report to the June 13, 2018 Community Development and Recreation Committee meeting on how Children's Services can work with the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards to develop an enforcement strategy for dogs in playgrounds being used by children who are in school based childcare centres for which the City is the service manager.
